summary: Data engineer with 5 years building batch and streaming pipelines on cloud data platforms.

bullets.text: Redesigned the nightly ETL pipeline using Airflow and dbt, cutting runtime from 4 hours to 45 minutes.
Built a streaming ingestion layer on Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming, processing 2M events/day.
Migrated on-prem PostgreSQL warehouse to AWS, reducing infrastructure cost by 30%.
Built and maintained Python ETL jobs feeding a Power BI reporting layer used by 50+ analysts.
Containerized the data platform with Docker and set up CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
Wrote Terraform modules to provision staging and production data infrastructure.
